description: One creative into a matched set of sizes for social posts, stories, link previews and display ads, in one folder. Each size either fills the frame (crop keeping the interesting part) or fits the whole creative over a blurred copy of itself. Sizes: ig-post 1080×1080, ig-portrait 1080×1350, ig-portrait-34 1080×1440, story 1080×1920, x-post 1600×900, dribbble 1600×1200, link 1200×628, youtube 1280×720, li-banner 1584×396, mrec 300×250, leaderboard 728×90, skyscraper 160×600, mobile-banner 320×50. Text layouts (headline, button) are on one.design/campaign-kit. [Pro tool.]

file.description: The photo or key visual. ~ is your home folder.

fit.description: "cover": fill each size, cropping to the most eye-catching part. "fill": the whole creative, with a blurred copy of it filling the space (like fit_fill).

name.description: Campaign name for the files, e.g. autumn-launch. Default: the image’s name.

output_dir.description: Where to put the kit folder. Default: next to the image.

scale.description: 1: exactly each size’s pixels (what ad networks want). 2: double, sharp on high-density screens (a 728×90 banner becomes 1456×180).
